_about: SYNTHETIC fixtures, hand-written in the per-citation format documented for CourtListener's Citation Lookup API v4 (https://wiki.free.law/c/courtlistener/help/api/rest/v4/citation-lookup). They are NOT CourtListener responses. Real cluster objects carry many more fields; only case_name, case_name_short, case_name_full, date_filed and absolute_url are included here. case_name and date_filed reflect each decision's public name and decision date. absolute_url values are the paths courtlistener.com redirected to for these citations when checked on 2026-10-31. For 925 F.3d 1339, courtlistener.com's public citation page returned 404 on 2026-10-31. start_index/end_index are filled in at lookup time from the local extractor. Run `preflight check --live` with COURTLISTENER_TOKEN for real lookups.
